name: Wiezen
description: Wiezen (Belgian Whist) is a Belgian 4-player trick-taking game with bidding and temporary alliances. 52-card deck, 13 each. Last card dealt = trump. Contracts: Troel (3 Aces, 4th Ace holder = partner), Solo (alone), Abondance (9+ alone), Misère (no tricks), Open Misère, Pico (exactly 1 trick), Solo Slim (all 13).

history.origins: Wiezen is the Flemish word for Whist. It is a Belgian trick-taking game with bidding, descended from Boston Whist rather than the classic 19th-century Whist fashionable across Europe. It is related to British Solo Whist and Dutch Rikken. Documented in the Turnhout region (Leo Dignef's thesis on card games in the Turnhoutse) and from play in Ravels near Turnhout; it became the national card game of Flemish Belgium and remains deeply rooted in Belgian pub culture.
timeline: 20th century: National card game of Flemish Belgium; documented in Turnhout region (Leo Dignef).

history.evolution: National card game of Flemish Belgium.

setup.deck: 52 cards. A high. 13 each (4+4+5). Last card = trump.
setup.dealing: 13 each in packets. Cards NOT shuffled between hands (only cut).

rules.objective: Fulfill your contract by taking the agreed number of tricks (or losing every trick in Misère), alone or with a temporary partner, to score payment from opponents.
rules.gameplay: Bidding: Troel (3 Aces), Vragen (propose partner), Solo (5+ alone), Abondance (9+ alone), Misère (no tricks/no trump), Open Misère (face-up), Pico (exactly 1), Solo Slim (all 13). Follow suit. Trump if possible.

variations.name: Kleine Miserie optional
variations.description: Many omit Kleine Miserie; Pico often included.
variations.emptyOverridesReason: Optional inclusion of Kleine Miserie; no engine constant overrides needed.

variations.name: Troel before bidding
variations.description: Some require Troel/Pass-Troel to be said before the bidding proper begins.
variations.emptyOverridesReason: Bidding order variant only; no engine constant overrides documented.

variations.name: Ronde Pas (Totale Miserie)
variations.description: When everyone passes, a preset list of no-trump games is played in rotation (e.g. lose last trick, no Queens, fewest tricks).
variations.emptyOverridesReason: Ronde Pas adds rotation of no-trump games; overrides to be added when implementing.

variations.name: Carte Blanche
variations.description: Player with no J/Q/K may call Carte Blanche before bidding; only Miserie op Tafel and Solo Slim then allowed.
variations.emptyOverridesReason: Carte Blanche restricts allowed bids; overrides to be added when implementing.

variations.name: Vuilbakwiezen
variations.description: Dealer gets 1 card; each opponent 17 then discards 4; dealer's card plus discards form dealer's hand.
variations.emptyOverridesReason: Vuilbakwiezen changes deal and hand size; overrides to be added when implementing.

scoring.description: Contract-dependent. Higher contracts = more points. Failed = negative.
